main.description: Fetch the comment thread on a node (document or comment). Serves only what the caller may read.

on.description: The id of the node the comments hang on.

profiles.description: An object from DID to profileView, for everyone who wrote one of these.

viewer.description: Where the caller stands in the thread's context, which says what they may delete: what they wrote, or as an owner anything.

did.description: The caller. Absent for someone not signed in.
